skills.name: Fist Wind
skills.description:
Badang unleashes a gust of <font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color='#D58E1F'>( +90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The <font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies. <font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 <font color='#404495'>(Chivalry Fist)</font> stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 <font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.
skills.tips: Try to use Qigong Fist and trigger Passive and control enemies at some important moments.

skills.name: Fist Break
skills.description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in his path while gaining a 350<font color='#D58E1F'>( +150% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Badang removes the obstacle he created.
skills.tips: This skill can be stacked. It's Badang's core skill. Try to better use Qigong Fist and slow enemies down to increase the hit rate of Fist Break. With the help of the obstacles, his Passive can deal more damage and better control the enemies.

skills.name: Fist Crack
skills.description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60<font color='#D58E1F'>( +54% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The <font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30<font color='#D58E1F'>( +27% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.
skills.tips: Fist Crack's fist wind can trigger the explosion of his Passive.

skills.name: Chivalry Fist
skills.description:
After every 4 Basic Attacks, Badang's next Basic Attack deals 50<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (minions and creeps are stunned directly).
<font color='#404495'>(Fist Wind)</font> generated by Badang's skills can also trigger this effect.
skills.tips: Better use the control effect with Fist Break and slay enemies with ease.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.des: Unique Passive - Swift: Every 1% extra Crit Chance gained is converted into 1% extra Attack Speed.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: The first equipment set is highly recommended. Haas's Claws provides HP Regen, and the Passive effects of Endless Battle suit Badang's Qigong fist very well. Wings of the Apocalypse Queen and Immortality ensures Badang's survival ability in teamfights. Blade of Despair greatly enhances Badang's attack in the late game.
